# Round 0 Summary

## What Was Implemented

Added a tiny, deterministic Python greeting module per the plan:

- `greeting.py` defines a single public function `greeting()` that returns
  exactly the string `"hello"`. No third-party dependencies, standard
  library only.
- `test_greeting.py` imports `greeting` from `greeting.py` and uses the
  `unittest` module to assert `greeting() == "hello"`.

This satisfies AC1 (exact return value), AC2 (unittest coverage), AC4
(standard library only), and AC5 (change limited to the greeting module and
its test).

## Files Changed

- `greeting.py` (new)
- `test_greeting.py` (new)

No other files were created, modified, or deleted.
